title: Revenue booked early
summary: Invoice INV-KJP-2609-00363 is dated 30 Sep but was delivered 2 Oct, so ¥42.7m of revenue is in the wrong month.

replies.author: glAccountant
replies.text: Logistics confirms it left Tsukuba on 1 Oct. The month-end review missed it.

resolution.log: Revenue booked early: INV-KJP-2609-00363 moved to October. September revenue down ¥42.7m.

notChecked: The delivery note: the files have no delivery confirmations, only the invoice’s delivery date.
rule: Revenue belongs to the month of delivery.
evidence: INV-KJP-2609-00363 (¥42.7m net) is dated 30 Sep 2026 but delivered 2 Oct 2026. Revenue belongs to the next month.

decision.question: September is locked. Where should the ¥42.7m correction go?
decision.basis: The policy puts revenue in the month of delivery. It doesn’t say whether a locked month is reopened.

options.label: Reopen September
options.description: Reverse the invoice in September and rebook it on 2 Oct. H1 is right for the 6 Nov earnings release.

options.label: Keep September locked
options.description: Post nothing. List the ¥42.7m for the auditors’ interim review, and the year to date is right from October.

tool.running: Reading the delivery date on INV-KJP-2609-00363…
tool.done: Read the delivery date on INV-KJP-2609-00363

entry.title: Reverse INV-KJP-2609-00363 in September?
entry.reason: Delivered 2 Oct. The invoice is rebooked on that date, in October.
entry.changes: Five lines in KJP, dated 30 Sep: revenue, tax and the receivable come off, and the stock goes back. September reopens for this entry only.
entry.reaches: The KJP ledger and the H1 consolidation, which takes the new September figures.
entry.outcome: Posted by you. INV-KJP-2609-00363 is reversed in September.
entry.stopped: Not posted. Choose again, or leave it open.
entry.log: Revenue booked early: INV-KJP-2609-00363 moved to October. September revenue down ¥42.7m.

record.title: List INV-KJP-2609-00363 for the auditors?
record.reason: September stays as booked. The review list gains one line: ¥42.7m of revenue a month early.
record.changes: Nothing in the books. The review list gains one line.
record.outcome: Added by you. September stays as booked.
record.stopped: Not added. Choose again, or leave it open.
record.log: Revenue booked early: ¥42.7m listed for the auditors' review. September stays as booked.

delegate.reason: The policy doesn’t decide this. I chose it so H1 is right for the 6 Nov earnings release.

decision.skipped: Skipped. INV-KJP-2609-00363 stays open until someone decides.

title: Duplicate payment
summary: KUS entered supplier invoice MFL-58821 twice and paid $48,216.40 both times.

replies.author: apLead
replies.text: The duplicate check compares the description too. "June" and "Jun" got past it.

replies.author: apLead
replies.text: Midwest Freight has agreed to credit $48,216.40 against the next invoice.

resolution.log: Duplicate payment: $48,216.40 to be credited by the supplier.

rule: A supplier invoice number is entered and paid once.
evidence: KUS entered supplier invoice MFL-58821 twice (API-KUS-2607-00007 and API-KUS-2607-00011), $48,216.40 each, and paid both.

title: Self-approved entry
summary: JE-KUK-2608-00055 moved £18,400 from advertising to prepaid expenses. The same person created and approved it.

replies.author: glAccountant
replies.text: Fiona has reversed it in October, and the UK approval rule now blocks self-approval.

resolution.log: Self-approved entry: JE-KUK-2608-00055 reversed; self-approval now blocked in KUK.

notChecked: The approver’s limit: the employee master isn’t in these files.
rule: One person creates a manual journal entry, and another approves it.
evidence: JE-KUK-2608-00055 (KUK, 31 Aug 2026) moves £18,400 from advertising to prepaid expenses. The same person, E3003, created and approved it. Whether it was over their limit needs the employee master, which isn’t in these files.

title: Credit limit
summary: Great Lakes Duplicating Supply was over its $600,000 credit limit at 8 month-ends before the credit hold on 10 Sep 2026.

replies.author: usCredit
replies.text: Legal decides on recovery by 30 Oct, and nothing changes until then.

notChecked: Whether legal will pursue recovery: the decision is due 30 Oct.
rule: A customer’s balance stays within its credit limit.
evidence: Its balance was over the $600,000 limit in Sep 2025, Nov 2025 and every month from Mar 2026 to Aug 2026. The account went on credit hold on 10 Sep 2026, and the last payment arrived 21 Jul 2026.
